Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥77,774 million, a decrease of 5.5% from the previous year. The company cites lower selling prices than the previous year, due to a fall in LP gas import prices, as the reason. The number of directly sold customer households was approx. 568 thousand, a decrease of approx. 7 thousand from the end of the previous year.
